modernization_manifesto.description: High-level architectural guidelines injected into Spec Extractor prompts.

id.description: Stable project identifier used for provenance. Lowercase snake_case (e.g. 'vb6_smias', 'cobol_ecbls') or a 'PRJ-...' code — both accepted.

plugins.description: List of language plugins to load into the microkernel.

target_architecture.description: OPTIONAL, SOURCE-LANGUAGE-INDEPENDENT target-platform architecture contract consumed by Stage 6 (Target Architecture Synthesis). Describes the NEW system only — it contains no reference to source constructs (forms, copybooks, DataWindows), so the identical schema serves PowerBuilder, VB6, COBOL, and any future source language; the source paradigm lives in project.source_paradigm + project.plugins. All fields are optional: any left blank are proposed by the generator (grounded in target_stack + modernization_manifesto) and surfaced in the architecture doc's open_questions for the human approval gate. Values are also target-tech-agnostic (free strings / lists / a style string), so a future .NET or Go target needs different values, not a different schema.

topology.description: Target deployment topology for Stage 6. Recommended default 'modular-monolith' (maximises autonomy for unattended code generation). 'microservices' is allowed but flagged higher-risk. Free string; when unset the generator defaults to modular-monolith (or maps from target_stack.architecture) and records the choice in the decision ledger.

system.description: Tier-B system/platform architecture inputs consumed by Stage 6. All optional: any blank field is DECIDED by the generator from a grounded default (config + modernization_manifesto + best practice) and recorded in the decision ledger — never raised as a blocking question. Source-language-independent (describes the target only).

identity.description: Authentication ISSUANCE (not just enforcement): who mints tokens, refresh, and the RBAC role source.

build.description: Target build tooling, e.g. 'Maven (backend) + pnpm (frontend)'. Free string — no assumed language.

runtime.description: Target runtime(s)/versions, e.g. 'JDK 21 / Node 20'. Free string.

tech_allowlist.description: The ONLY technologies the code generator may use. The Stage-6 critic rejects any framework/library/version not on this list (anti-hallucination guardrail). Recommended to fill.

architecture_style.description: Named target style. Common values: 'layered' | 'hexagonal' | 'modular-monolith' | 'microservices'. Free string to remain future-proof; when set it implies default layering if 'layers' is omitted.

layers.description: Explicit logical layers and their permitted dependencies. Omit to let the generator derive them from architecture_style.

allowed_dependencies.description: IDs of layers this layer may depend on.

component_types.description: Catalog of the code artifact kinds the generator emits, with where/how to place and name them.

naming_conventions.description: Free-form naming rules (packages, classes, endpoints, tables, etc.).

cross_cutting.description: Cross-cutting concern decisions (security, logging, error handling, transactions, configuration, i18n, ...).

nfrs.description: Non-functional targets the architecture must satisfy (performance, concurrency, availability, batch SLAs, ...).

batch_strategy.description: TARGET batch technology + policy. Populated more heavily by batch-centric sources (e.g. COBOL) and lightly by UI-centric ones (e.g. VB6), but uses the same keys either way. Online-vs-batch classification itself comes paradigm-neutrally from module_manifest execution_track.

source_filters.description: OPTIONAL vendor-library/framework exclusion for scan + module derivation. Framework code (e.g. PowerBuilder PFC) is not migrated as business modules, so it is skipped. Per-language defaults come from prompts/language_profiles.yaml (library_excludes); set use_paradigm_defaults=false to disable them, or add exclude_dirs / exclude_globs to extend.

use_paradigm_defaults.description: Apply the active language's library_excludes from language_profiles.yaml (default true).

exclude_dirs.description: Additional directory names to exclude (matched case-insensitively against any path segment).

llm.description: LLM provider configuration for the RIP pipeline.
